plain_english_revision: The amendment removes a general prohibition on new municipal occupational taxes for one specific type of municipality: Class 2 municipalities. This means those localities can now impose or modify such taxes without needing prior authorization by local law.
candidate_position_supported: Exempting Class 2 municipalities from the prohibition on new occupational taxes (as defined in HB147).
evidence_quotes: This act does not apply to a Class 2 municipality.
Section 2. This act does not apply to a Class 2 municipality.
review_reason: The amendment text is clear and unambiguous, with no reliance on unseen language or procedural ambiguity.
